title: LIN-4254 piece 5: task-page suites onto loadWorld (task-page-client, task-page-question, lin-3975)
description:
**Piece 5 of LIN-4254: task-page.** Lands after Piece 4. (`close-out-client` is split into its own subtask, which follows this one and is gated on LIN-4304.)

## Implemented

Implemented as approved (no deviations from the plan slice): the three suites (`task-page-client`, `task-page-question`, `lin-3975-proposal-refresh`) run on `loadWorld` with their private `vm` sandboxes deleted and their census entries removed, over the server's real renderers. PR: [https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2330](<https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2330>) (merged as `90542b2c`). The full history, including the pre-prune slice of the plan, is preserved in the task snapshots and the comment trail.

## Acceptance

* Each of the three files is either on `loadWorld` with its sandbox deleted and its census entry removed, or still listed with a true stop comment.
* Names and counts are preserved.
* Newly red tests are classified.
* The `CustomEvent` comment is present in `task-page-question`.
* Census, line budget and full unit suite are green.

---

**Parent:** LIN-4254 (Move the 16 not-attempted client-test stubs onto the shared fake). This piece's starting point is the parent's approved **Implementation Plan** in LIN-4254's description, plus the builder notes in its approving Plan Review Verdict (comment `c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7`). Follow it. Where the code shows it wrong, change course and say so in a comment on LIN-4254.

**Rules for every piece (from the plan):** "Moved" means the suite runs on `loadWorld` (`tests/unit/helpers/client-world.js` over `tests/unit/helpers/fake-dom.js`) and its private `vm.createContext` sandbox is deleted. Do not wrap the old sandbox around the fake. Slices and scripts that query the DOM at load use `loadWorld({ scripts: [] })`, then `parse(markup, document.body)`, then `world.run(source)`, as `observation-ruling-delivery` and LIN-4284 do. Router markup comes from the server's real renderer where one exists, not from hand-written HTML. Do not widen the fake. A file that hits an API the fake does not model (a `FakeDomError`, a `style` or layout read, or an unmodelled method such as `click()`) stays on `HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES` with a `// stop:` comment naming the API and `file:line`. A `querySelector: () => null` stub that becomes a real tree can bring dead paths to life. A test that goes red there is a finding: classify it as a real client bug, a vacuous pass or a fake gap, and list it in the PR. Never loosen the test. Test names are kept. Do not split a file to keep a count, and do not copy a fixture.

**Testing strategy (every move PR):** an assertion map; before/after sorted test names, diffed against base; one mutation per load-bearing assertion, showing it goes red; and green runs of `fake-dom-census.test.js`, `claude-md-line-budget.test.js` and the full unit suite. The census count only falls. Every remaining entry's reason is true at merge.

**Grounding commits:** plan and approving review at `b581ac92` (Surveys at `b581ac926`); LIN-4292 landed as `b389f9b0`. Re-check `git log b581ac92..origin/main -- tests/unit public` before starting.

**Session fit:** fits one session
**Plan-review due:** no — covered by LIN-4254's approving plan-review (comment c1d9a66c-fb1a-4f25-903c-e11227c24ba7, rev 2)

comments.body:
PR: https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2330 (branch feat/lin-4311-task-page-suites-loadworld, commit 39d28717)

All three suites are on loadWorld with their private vm sandboxes removed, and they are off HAND_WRITTEN_FAKE_DOM_FILES. No stop comments were needed.

- task-page-client (52 tests): page-level suites run task-page.js over renderTaskPage markup. Stage rows, context panels, and the guest brief pre come from the real renderers. The apply() case with real close-out.js runs on the same world.
- task-page-question (22 tests): poll replies are built by renderTaskStatus / renderTaskQuestion. Adds the present-tense CustomEvent-absent note (it was not in the file before).
- lin-3975-proposal-refresh (9 tests): the server's fold markup (renderTaskChatFold) carries the hooks, so the router moves.

Checks: sorted test names identical to base for all three files. Full unit suite 23,923 pass, 0 fail. Census and line-budget green. 18 mutation witnesses went red and were restored. One existing test gained an assertion for the server-opened-row memory branch, which no test covered.

CI on the PR: all green (Unit tests, E2E shards 1-4, Secret scan).

## Review — LIN-4311

Reviewed PR https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2330 at head `39d287176a0e873714606f7c8cca3d61c1304d30` (base `ff6a69fa`; `origin/main` has since gained only `5c63aa26`, a docs paper, which touches no file here).

CI: green on head `39d28717`: Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4 and Secret scan. I also re-ran the gates locally.

### Scope vs plan
- The diff touches only the three suites, the census and two new shared helpers (`helpers/task-page-body.js`, `helpers/task-page-loop.js`). This matches the plan's slice. No `public/` or `lib/` file changed. The `loop` fixture is shared, not copied.
- All three files run on `loadWorld`, with no `vm` import left. All three census entries are removed and no stop comment was needed. The census count fell by 3, from 15 entries to 12.
- **Router markup:** pages come from `renderTaskPage` (body via `bodyOf`), the track from `renderTaskTrack`, context from `renderTaskContext`, the card from `renderTaskQuestion`, and the fold from `renderTaskChatFold`. This meets the "real renderer" rule. The one hand-written piece is a `<section data-testid="task-page-answer">` wrapper around `renderTaskStatus` output in `answerOf`. That is acceptable.
- **lin-3975 hooks, confirmed from source:** `lib/render-task-chat.js:43` draws `id` as `<input type="hidden">` and `:47` draws `question` as `<input type="text">`. Both are `<input>`, not `<textarea>`.
- **`CustomEvent` comment:** present in `task-page-question` and written in the present tense. Its cite `question-cards.js:235-238` is accurate at HEAD.
- **Names and counts:** I re-diffed sorted passing test names against `origin/main` myself. They are identical for all three files: 52, 22 and 9 tests.
- **Local runs on head:** task-page-client 52/52, task-page-question 22/22, lin-3975 9/9, fake-dom-census 49/49, claude-md-line-budget 2/2.

### Regression check
`git log` since ticket creation shows no change to `public/task-page.js`, `task-chat.js`, `question-cards.js`, `lib/render-task-*.js` or the fake/world helpers. The PR changes tests only, so it cannot re-introduce a fixed bug in source.

### Mutation check (each mutation reverted afterwards)
**Red, as they should be (14):**
- `task-chat.js`: drop `propose` (lin-3975 red), always-propose (red), gate off `onProposed` (red).
- `task-page.js` `syncQuestion`: never-remove (2 red), ignore the owner marker (red), never reload (red).
- `applyOpenMemory`: do not remember a server-opened row (red; this is the PR's newly added assertion).
- `createOpenMemory` empty (3 red); `openCheckIns` empty (red); `restoreCheckIns` no-op (red).
- `mountWidgets`: drop `source: source` (red).
- 404 gate: no gone notice (red).
- `repaintHeader` no-op (6 red, but only in the LIN-3448 `apply()` suite; see finding 1).

**Green — load-bearing tests the move made vacuous (2 findings):**
1. **LIN-3373 `repaintHeader keeps the load-time summary`.** None of its three tests goes red when `repaintHeader` is a no-op. Changing `(status || answer).appendChild(summaryNode)` to `answer.appendChild(summaryNode)` stays green on head but goes **red on base** (the old test pinned "append into the status block"). The rewrite dropped the "header was repainted" and "carried into the status block" pins. Test 2 also no longer checks that the *new* summary is the one kept.
2. **LIN-3356 `tickClocks refreshes running counters and "started ago" labels`.** It stays green with either tick loop disabled: `if (span)` → `if (false)`, or `if (ago)` → `if (false)`. Both go **red on base**. Cause: the track is rendered at the same `now` the test later asserts, so the server text already reads `running 4m` / `started 2h 5m ago` and `tickClocks` has nothing to change. This is the vacuous-pass case the plan warns about when a real tree replaces a stub.

Both are "never loosen the test" violations. The PR's "18 mutation witnesses" did not cover these two paths.

### Isolated, or one of a class?
The class is "a moved assertion pre-satisfied by the server's own markup". I tested every load-bearing client path in the three suites (list above). Only the two above are affected. Cases (a)–(h) of LIN-3448 moved from exact `innerHTML` equality to `textOf` comparison, which is weaker, but every mutation I tried there went red, so I don't count them as findings. No sibling exists outside the three files: the other pieces (LIN-4307..4310) are already Done and are not part of this ticket.

### What CI Did Not Prove
- **Inside** (the plan's rules "never loosen the test" and "one mutation per load-bearing assertion, showing it goes red"): the LIN-3373 `repaintHeader` tests pass with the carry and the repaint removed. Settle **before the merge** with fix A below. Distinguishing check: on `public/task-page.js:540`, `(status || answer).appendChild` → `answer.appendChild` must turn `a header with no summary does not delete the load-time one` red, and inserting `return;` at the top of `repaintHeader` must turn all three LIN-3373 tests red.
- **Inside** (same rule): the LIN-3356 `tickClocks` test passes with ticking disabled. Settle **before the merge** with fix B below. Distinguishing check: `if (span)` → `if (false)` at `public/task-page.js:220`, and `if (ago)` → `if (false)` at `:226`, must each turn the test red.

### Fixes for close-out (test-only; I verified them locally as a trial patch and reverted it)
**A. `tests/unit/task-page-client.test.js`, describe `repaintHeader keeps the load-time summary (LIN-3373)`.**
- In test 1, after `'the summary survives the repaint'`, add:
  `assert.ok(answer.querySelector('[data-testid="task-page-status"] [data-testid="task-page-summary"]'), 'carried into the repainted status block');`
  `assert.notEqual(answer.querySelector('[data-testid="task-page-status"]').getAttribute('data-status'), 'running', 'the header was repainted');`
- In test 2, after the `length, 1` assert, add:
  `assert.match(answer.querySelector('[data-testid="task-page-summary"]').textContent, /Now something else/, 'the new summary, not the old one');`

**B. Same file, test `tickClocks refreshes running counters…`.**
- Render the track a minute stale: change `], new Date(now));` to `], new Date(now - 60 * 1000));`.
- Before `tickClocks(...)`, add the precondition:
  `assert.deepEqual(track.doc.querySelectorAll('[data-running-since]').map((el) => el.textContent), ['running 3m'], 'drawn a minute ago');`
- The existing post-tick asserts (`running 4m`, `started 4m ago`, `started 2h 5m ago`) stay as they are.

**Result with A and B applied:** 52/52 green. Each mutation above goes red (carry-to-answer: 1 red; running and started no-tick: 1 red each; no-op `repaintHeader`: 7 red).

**Nits (optional, same PR):**
- `tests/unit/lin-3975-proposal-refresh.test.js:230` still says "its helper is read through a vm". It is now `loadWorld`.
- `tests/unit/task-page-question.test.js` has a doubled blank line before `describe('a joined ruling row on the task page (LIN-3959)'`.

### Verdict
Approve — conditional on close-out discharging the ledger

The migration is complete and faithful: real renderers, census entries removed, names and counts identical, CI green. Two moved tests became vacuous, and the test-only fixes A and B above must land before merge, re-witnessed by the named mutations.

## Close-out — LIN-4311

**Merged:** https://github.com/JKershaw/LinearViewer/pull/2330, squash-merged as `90542b2c`, pinned to head `d15fcfd6` (`--match-head-commit`). The three task-page suites (`task-page-client` 52 tests, `task-page-question` 22, `lin-3975-proposal-refresh` 9) are on `loadWorld`, their `vm` sandboxes are gone, and their census entries are removed. The review verdict was Approve, conditional on the two ledger items below.

### Changes I made after approval (commit `d15fcfd6`, tests only, no `public/` or `lib/` change)
- **Review fix A** (finding 1, LIN-3373 `repaintHeader` tests) in `task-page-client.test.js`. Test 1 now also asserts that the summary is carried into the repainted `task-page-status` block and that the header was repainted (`data-status` is not `running`). Test 2 now asserts that the new summary text is the one kept.
- **Review fix B** (finding 2, LIN-3356 `tickClocks` test) in `task-page-client.test.js`. The track is rendered a minute stale (`now - 60 * 1000`). A precondition asserts `['running 3m']` before the tick. The existing post-tick asserts (`running 4m`, `started 4m ago`, `started 2h 5m ago`) are unchanged.
- **Nits:** the stale "read through a vm" comment at `lin-3975-proposal-refresh.test.js:230` now says `loadWorld`. The doubled blank line in `task-page-question.test.js` is removed. Both answer review's optional nits.

### Ledger (both items inside, both settled before the merge)
| Item | Distinguishing check (run on the fixed tree; source restored after each) | Result |
|---|---|---|
| LIN-3373 `repaintHeader` vacuous | `public/task-page.js:540` `(status \|\| answer).appendChild` → `answer.appendChild` | 1 red |
| | `return;` at the top of `repaintHeader` | 7 red |
| LIN-3356 `tickClocks` vacuous | `if (span)` → `if (false)` (`task-page.js:219`) | 1 red |
| | `if (ago)` → `if (false)` (`task-page.js:225`) | 1 red |

Before the fix, the carry-to-answer, `if (span)` and `if (ago)` mutations stayed green on head, per review.

### CI
CI exists (`.github/workflows/test.yml`). On `d15fcfd6`, a fresh read of the rollup showed Unit tests, E2E shards 1–4, Secret scan and CI success all SUCCESS. Locally on the same tree: task-page-client 52/52, task-page-question 22/22, lin-3975 9/9, fake-dom-census 49/49, claude-md-line-budget 2/2, and the full unit suite 23,923 pass, 0 fail.

### Post-deploy
None. The change is tests only, and the repo has no deploy workflow. No live check was needed or skipped.

### Follow-ups and related tickets
- The ledger had no outside items, so I filed nothing.
- LIN-4312 (piece 6) stays Todo. It is gated on LIN-4304 and is unaffected by this merge.
- LIN-4254 (parent) stays open for LIN-4312.
- Description archived (snapshot verified, captured 11:03:35) and pruned: the discharged plan-slice section is now an "Implemented" stub. Acceptance, rules, session-fit and plan-review lines are kept word for word.
